content.comment_body: Hello, I need to convert a 4-6mA signal to a 4-20mA range. However, when the input current exceeds 6mA, the analog output surpasses the intended 0-1000 scale. What steps can I take to address this issue? Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is experiencing difficulties with signal scaling, specifically when mapping a 4-6mA input to a 4-20mA output; values above 6mA cause the output to exceed the target digital scale of 0-1000. There is no practical advice or solution offered, and guidance on handling this configuration in [company_name] hardware or software is absent.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants the software or module to perform a linear conversion of a 4-6mA input signal to a 4-20mA output so that all readings remain within the standard 0-1000 digital scale, preventing any overflow values.
